text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, world...!! Now then, I 
wonder what kind of possibilities I'll 
reveal to—
Gyaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What happened?! I thought I just heard a 
scream from over—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for making a commotion! El asked 
me to teach her zazen, so...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Th-that scream came from zazen 
meditation...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, do you think you could teach me 
too? If it's enough to make El scream like 
that, I'm definitely intrigued!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
P-Pearl-senpai... you really shouldn't...! 
El gave up in just 5 minutes...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry! That is precisely why I'll 
show you the possibilities!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now close your eyes, stay as still as 
possible... and focus on facing your inner 
self...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(――Hehe. Even in the darkness, the heart 
is free. It can go anywhere.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel the breeze blowing across the 
palace gardens, too.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Even walking along a snowy path—)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(That's it! How about I just fly all the 
way around the world like this!?)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Races all over the world... regardless of 
country, distance... or even era, I'll run 
them all—!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(! ...Ah... so that was it... My potential 
is—)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Pearl-senpai. Please open your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, all done already?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai didn't move at all, YES! She 
was just like a stone!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Your concentration was truly phenomenal. 
How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... It feels almost like being 
reborn. Traveling the world showed me 
things I'd never seen before, too...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Travel... the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ In other words—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I have this heart... My 
potential is limitless!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Grass, let me thank you! And also—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good night, world...♪ Today, I was the one 
shown what's possible.
